label: Watts thermodynamic budget: Machine B/C hybrid path
description: Extends Pass 4337 Landauer budget to the B/C hybrid execution path. Machine B (symmetric irreversible, 6 opcodes) and Machine C (biased reversible, 8 opcodes) share frame coordinate [2,0,2,x], enabling a hybrid schedule that amortises irreversibility cost across symmetric and biased sectors.

hybrid_schedule.description: Interleave B (irreversible setup) with C (reversible compute) at 1:3 ratio

conclusion: Hybrid B/C schedule reduces Landauer dissipation by 4x vs pure-B execution. Machine D (fully reversible) remains the thermodynamic optimum at 0W compute cost; readout at 1.6 pW dominates in all cases. The B/C hybrid is the practical minimum for non-reversible workloads requiring symmetric opcodes.
